name: ilang-deai
description: Edits AI-drafted text to sound naturally human. Three-layer editing: clean filler phrases, restructure rhythm, mark positions for authentic personal voice. Supports Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean. By iLang.

displayDescription.en: Edits AI-drafted text so it sounds like you wrote it: removes filler phrases, restructures rhythm, marks positions for your authentic voice. Works in Chinese, English, Japanese and Korean, with a self-check report after every edit. Built on the I-Lang protocol by iLang.
